scenario: DPR-08 silent BOQ project resolution isolated browser regression

fixture.persistenceMode: fixture in-memory adapter with sessionStorage records and browser autosave storage

assertions.A: Fresh Guided and Detailed DPRs resolve the site's BOQ automatically with no visible BOQ-project selector/status or No BOQ project copy.
assertions.B: An unscheduled BOQ item remains selectable and displays the Not linked to a programme bar (optional) hint.
assertions.C: Positive project pins survive rendered Guided Save Draft and Detailed/Edit Save Progress, then reopen on the same fixture drafts.
assertions.D: Positive project pins and unscheduled items survive rendered Restore actions from local Guided and Detailed autosaves.
assertions.E: A site with two active BOQ projects automatically selects the active project with programme bars and does not expose a chooser.

limitations: All GET/PATCH requests and persisted records stay inside the fixture's in-memory/sessionStorage adapter.
The autosave blob is synthetic browser storage seeded by this verifier; no real customer persistence is exercised.
The verifier clicks rendered controls and inspects browser requests; it does not call React handlers directly.
verify-dpr-null-project.mjs and its screenshots intentionally remain excluded because they assert the obsolete manual saved-null recovery chooser.
